retrievalProfile.description: A retro album cover featuring multiple figures with horizontal motion blur and ghosting, framed by a vertical Japanese-style sidebar.
excludeWhen: a clean sharp portrait is required
modern minimalist digital design is requested
no text or sidebar is desired

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring three figures captured with significant horizontal motion blur, creating a 'ghosting' trail effect against a dark background. The layout is defined by a prominent vertical blue sidebar on the left containing vertical text and a top-aligned title in a stylized script.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal motion trails contrasting with vertical sidebar orientation
Triadic color scheme of yellow, purple, and blue against a dark void
Soft, ethereal human forms against sharp, geometric layout elements
Hierarchy established by the top-aligned script and the left-aligned vertical bar
coreInvariants: Vertical sidebar (obi strip) on the left edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures arranged diagonally from top-left to bottom-center, filling the central and right portions of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical blue sidebar on the left acts as a structural anchor for the fluid imagery.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the motion trails from left to right, then is pulled back by the vertical text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black/dark brown negative space surrounds the subjects, emphasizing the motion trails.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark brown/black background providing high contrast for subjects.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blue used for the vertical sidebar and metadata text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted yellow, lavender, and pink used for clothing and display type.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-value background with medium-saturation highlights on the subjects' skin and clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or high-chroma modern colors

letterConstructionRules: Display title uses a heavy, rounded script with thick strokes and thin connectors
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title characters feature soft, bulbous terminals
Vertical text uses blocky, uniform-width characters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Fluid, organic script for the title paired with rigid, geometric vertical blocks for the sidebar.

avoid: Modern geometric sans-serifs for the title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, mid-century script feel
Suitable for the dense vertical sidebar text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark, low-key portrait of three people with heavy horizontal motion blur and ghosting trails. Use a palette of yellow and lavender for their clothing. The background should be nearly black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a solid blue vertical bar on the far left. Place vertical white sans-serif text inside the bar. Add a large, rounded script title at the top center in a soft pink or lavender color.

verificationChecks: Is there a distinct horizontal ghosting effect on the subjects?
Is the sidebar on the left blue with vertical text?
Is the title font a rounded, high-contrast script?
Is the background dark and atmospheric?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the portrait

mustAchieve: Clean graphic separation between the image and the sidebar

postGenerationChecks: Check that the motion blur is strictly horizontal.
Ensure the sidebar text is vertically stacked, not just rotated.
Verify the script title is centered at the top.
Confirm the color palette feels vintage and muted.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Long Exposure Portrait] with [Horizontal Ghosting] + [Vertical Sidebar Layout] + [Retro Script Typography].
